subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official model/session reconcile-reset surface, and if so which explicit session, agent, provider, and auth pins may it clear by default versus only under scoped flags?
rationale: The remaining work changes how operators repair persisted session state, explicit user model/auth choices, agent-level overrides, generated model catalog state, and provider routing; source inspection cannot safely choose those compatibility semantics.

options.title: Add dry-run plus opt-in clear
options.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear session, agent, or auth overrides.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Do not add new reset commands yet; instead improve status, doctor, and the narrower open trackers for shadowed defaults, invalid model refs, and resolver drift.

options.title: Change precedence automatically
options.body: Make default-model changes or resets automatically override stored session or agent pins, accepting a deliberate compatibility break for durable selections.

recommendation.title: Add dry-run plus opt-in clear
recommendation.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear session, agent, or auth overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about adding a core CLI/operator surface and compatibility semantics, and steipete has the clearest relevant model CLI ownership signal in the inspected history.
